newsitem.title: USA: U.S. has no comment on Lebed dismissal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. has no comment on Lebed dismissal.

text.p: The U.S. State Department declined comment on the dismissal Thursday of Russian security chief Alexander Lebed, calling it an internal Russian matter.
"The U.S. has no comment. It is an internal affair of the Russian government and the Russian people," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said in a statement to reporters.
Russian President Boris Yeltsin announced Lebed's dismissal on national television. He accused Lebed of "a number of mistakes which are impermissible in Russia's interests."
The United States has had mixed feelings about Lebed, a reserve general who scored a strong 15 percent in the first round of Russia's presidential election last June.

Washington welcomed Lebed's success in negotiating an end to fighting in Chechnya, and also praised comments he made during a visit to Brussels this month which appeared to take a flexible view of NATO expansion.
But U.S. officials have also seen him as something of a "loose cannon" and have condemned comments he made which they said were hostile to religious groups including Jews and Roman Catholics.
